title: tanacetum multicaule
intro: Tanacetum multicaule, commonly known as Tatarian chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum multicaule include calming the nervous system, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Tanacetum multicaule include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
